title: Only 7% Pass This Intelligence Test
summary: Follow patterns, compare codes and connect the clues in a varied reasoning challenge.

landing.intro:
Read the clues. Make the connections.
Put your thinking to the test.

about.body:
Explore number patterns, word relationships, logic, directions and attention to detail. Each set changes the kind of thinking involved.

Every question provides the rule or the clues needed to choose an answer. Take the time you need; there is no speed score. Checkpoints reflect the topic you just completed, followed by an overall result and optional answer review.

This entertainment challenge gives a quiz score. It is not a standardised IQ test and does not measure clinical or professional cognitive ability.

steps: Read the clues and choose one answer.
See your topic profile at each checkpoint and continue to a new challenge.
Reveal your overall result, then optionally review the answers you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a standardised intelligence, IQ, aptitude, educational or psychological assessment.
